findings.desc: ReviewAssuranceFloorReport interface and formatReviewAssuranceFloorFailure diagnostic output omit storyFilesHash: the floor declares it mirrors review-escalation, but review-escalation exposes a top-level storyFilesHash:string|null field in its report (consumed in diagnostic lines at review-escalation.ts:586) and floor does not. Callers cannot observe which storyFilesHash the floor computed, and the failure message has no storyFilesHash line. Files: packages/main/src/core/review-assurance-floor.ts:73-111 (ReviewAssuranceFloorReport interface missing storyFilesHash), packages/main/src/core/review-assurance-floor.ts:556-588 (return statement missing storyFilesHash spread), packages/main/src/core/review-assurance-floor.ts:709 (formatReviewAssuranceFloorFailure diagnostic missing storyFilesHash line).
